# Young Mary Joe

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Young Mary Joe is a French girl with a buxom build. She is also characterized by her broad face.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)_

## History

Young Mary Joe was hired by the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) family to take care of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) while their parents were away in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown). When [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) fell dangerously ill with croup, Mary Joe grew terrified and proved unable to handle the situation, prompting [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to run to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for help. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrived and successfully treated Minnie May's illness, relieving Mary Joe and saving the young girl's life.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P3](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P4](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII.
